attachments.displayName: Finally installed Android on my mom's Nook HD+. It took me multiple nights to finally find the right tutorial that worked for me. It seems that CyanogenMod development goes so fast by the time somebody posts a tutorial, it's already out of date. I'm liking it so far. It's definitely much improved over the stock Nook operating system. I have it installed to an SD card now and it would probably be much faster installed on the internal EMMC but I'm not pushing my luck on that yet.
